proposed_widenings.name: multi_mechanic_class_feature
proposed_widenings.justification: Font of Inspiration has two independent sub-mechanics: (1) a passive reset-cadence upgrade for Bardic Inspiration (not an activation at all), and (2) a spell-slot-cost recovery activation. The current ClassFeatureMechanics = ClassFeatureActivationMechanics supports exactly one family ('activation') with exactly one effect. There is no honest way to encode both sub-mechanics without either a new family or a multi-effect composition.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You now regain all your expended uses of Bardic Inspiration when you finish a Short or Long Rest. In addition, you can expend a spell slot (no action required) to regain one expended use of Bardic Inspiration.

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost: spell_slot
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell-slot recovery sub-mechanic is triggered by spending a spell slot with no action required. ClassFeatureActivationCost only supports 'free' and 'bonus_action'. A new variant is needed to represent spell-slot expenditure as an activation cost for class features.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can expend a spell slot (no action required) to regain one expended use of Bardic Inspiration

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect: recover_resource_use
proposed_widenings.justification: The effect of the spell-slot sub-mechanic is regaining 1 expended use of a named resource (Bardic Inspiration). ClassFeatureEffect only contains GrantExtraActionEffect and HealHpEffect — neither can represent refilling a use_count resource. This maps to the v4 'refund' procedure atom and 'refunds' relation, which exist in the taxonomy but have no corresponding surface variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: to regain one expended use of Bardic Inspiration

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect: upgrade_reset_cadence (or new family: passive_modifier)
proposed_widenings.justification: The first sub-mechanic passively changes the reset cadence of Bardic Inspiration from long-rest-only to short-or-long-rest. This is not an activation — it is a persistent rule modification on another feature's resource. The current surface has no 'passive_modifier' family and no ClassFeatureEffect variant for cross-feature reset-cadence modification. Either a new family or a new effect variant is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You now regain all your expended uses of Bardic Inspiration when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

notes: Neither sub-mechanic fits the current single-effect activation family. Part 1 (passive reset upgrade) is not an activation at all. Part 2 (spell-slot recovery) requires a new activation-cost variant (spell_slot) and a new effect variant (recover_resource_use, mapping to v4 'refund'). The structural widening is forced by the combination: the feature cannot be honestly split across two separate records (it is one class feature), yet no multi-mechanic composition or passive-modifier family exists in the surface. No dhall/json/trace files were authored.
